card.name: Historical dates and sums in old documents
card.fires_on: Parts of dates, money amounts and names in historical text from the 1500s to 1800s, such as a month name, a day number, or the space before a sum in crowns or livres.

modes.label: Dates
modes.description: Month names or day numbers inside an old-style date.
modes.example: By the King a Proclamation, First Day of<< January>> 1801.

modes.label: Sums of money
modes.description: The spot just before a figure for a pension or subsidy in old currency.
modes.example: He received forthwith a pension of<< >>2000 livres.

modes.label: Names
modes.description: Parts of historical personal names, often split partway.

card.plain: It lights up on dates, sums of money and names in old historical documents.
